bull.t: Record bookings and fast conversion pipeline
bull.b: A record backlog of 4,446 jobs with a median booking-to-revenue conversion of ~2 months gives durable near-term revenue visibility. Converted bookings can materially lift quarterly revenue toward breakeven if execution holds, making growth less dependent on spot lead generation.

bull.t: Higher ASP from battery attach improves per-job economics
bull.b: Rising ASP driven by battery attach upsells increases revenue and margin per installation, improving unit economics sustainably. As storage adoption grows, higher ASP reduces break-even volume needs and helps margins hold even if installation volumes vary.

bull.t: Cost cuts plus capital raise reduced leverage and improved runway
bull.b: A $41M raise deployed to cut debt and recurring OpEx reductions of ~$9.9M/quarter materially extend liquidity runway. Lower fixed costs and reduced interest burden are durable improvements that decrease cash-burn sensitivity while management executes the revenue ramp.

bear.t: Stressed balance sheet and ongoing cash burn
bear.b: Negative equity, material debt and repeated negative operating cash flow create persistent refinancing and solvency risk. This structural weakness limits strategic options, raises financing costs, and makes execution dependent on consistent revenue growth to stop cash bleed.

bear.t: Accounting restatements and finance leadership disruption
bear.b: Restatements and an interim CFO indicate persistent control and reporting risks that can impair investor confidence and lender trust. Remediating systems and rebuilding finance leadership is time-consuming and can constrain timely strategic decisions and access to capital.

bear.t: Dilutive, restrictive financing to preserve near-term liquidity
bear.b: Equity-in-lieu interest and secured convertibles ease short-term cash needs but dilute shareholders and encumber assets. Tight covenants and repurchase triggers restrict strategic flexibility and raise risk if revenue recovery slips, creating a durable constraint on growth options.
